t: Samhita: Significance and symbolism
s: December 7, 2025 - (1) Samhitas are ancient Ayurvedic texts, where the management of Mootrashmari was explained and information regarding Ashmari is available in almost all of them.[1] (2) Samhita is mentioned when referring to Aushadh Sevana Kalas, as they vary in names and number according to Samhita.[2] (3) These are ancient texts that provide thorough knowledge of Ayurveda in Sanskrita, guiding us towards different subjects with a primary focus on Shodhana and Shamana therapies.[3] (4) Samhita refers to the two greatest texts in Ayurveda, namely Charaka Samhita and Sushruta Samhita, which contain comprehensive knowledge about medicine and surgery.[4] (5) These are ancient texts, including Charak Samhita, Sushrut Samhita, Ashtang Hridayam, and Ashtang Sangraha, used as references in Ayurveda.[5]

t: Samhitas | Vedic Heritage Portal
s: The whole of the Rigveda-Samhita is in form of verses, known as Rik, from the root rc “to praise”. ‘Rik‘ is the name given to those Mantras which are meant for the praise of the deities. Thus the collection (Samhita) of Riks is known as Rigveda-Samhita.
